title: Close canonical relation-block wire round trip
finding: TypedRelationBlock emitted deterministic to_dict/to_json payloads but had no inverse parser, unlike the existing TensorView contract. No repository decoder bypass was found; the gap was that any future consumer would have to reconstruct nested records and EvidenceValue wire scalars ad hoc, risking drift around the semiring identity and bounded-scalar checks hardened in 01AK-01AO.
primary_claim: TypedRelationBlock.from_dict now provides one strict inverse for its canonical wire payload. Nested subject/signature/axis records reject unknown fields through the existing _record_payload helper, evidence-dag scalars decode only from the existing tagged wire shape, and the reconstructed block re-enters the same constructor-time semiring, CSR, and scalar bounds as direct construction.
gardener_decision: Follow the already-established TensorView from_dict pattern inside relation_blocks.py rather than add a codec module, registry, alternate scalar schema, or persistence layer. The parser is only a strict reconstruction path for the existing canonical projection payload.
acceptance: boolean, natural, tropical, and evidence-dag canonical payloads round-trip with identical block equality, payload, and digest
deserialized natural values still obey the shared MAX_NATURAL_BITS bound
deserialized unsupported semiring names still fail closed
nested unknown fields fail closed instead of being silently ignored
evidence-dag wire scalar tags cannot drift or acquire extra schema through the parser
no OwnerApproval, promotion, gate transition, or benchmark superiority claim is created

verification.claim: Only exact-head executed workflow steps count as evidence.

rollback: Revert G1-TENSOR-01AP; canonical relation blocks remain regenerable and no Forest/Fourfold authority changes.
